brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven-cell honeycomb work surface (central cell plus six neighbors)
requirements.evidence: 7 full bases at q,r: 0,0; 1,0; 1,-1; 0,-1; -1,0; -1,1; 0,1 – all level 0. Joint bolts locking 12 joints.
7 full top covers: cover:-1,0,0;full;top etc. one per cell, forming continuous deck.

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps placed on all 12 outer perimeter faces of honeycomb (3 caps on each of 6 outer cells). Includes caps at bearings 30,90,150,210,270,330 as offered. No open faces remain.

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (7 full bases), covered with 7 full top covers, outer perimeter finished with 18 solid end caps covering every open edge, joints locked.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
